title: Annual San Diego Summer Parks Program Returns
description:
San Diego – Music, movies, games and other free outdoor activities and entertainment will be featured at several local parks this summer at the fifth annual Parks After Dark program.
 
The San Diego Parks Foundation, the City of San Diego, Prebys Foundation, the County of San Diego, and Price Philanthropies Foundation announced the dates of this year’s program, which runs from June 5th through Aug. 1st.
 
The popular summer program will be held on Thursdays, Fridays, and Saturdays from 5 p.m. to 8 p.m. at five parks in the City of San Diego: City Heights, Linda Vista, Memorial, Skyline Hills and Silver Wing Recreation Centers.
